insights.title: Back is far under the productive range
insights.body: Back has 4 sets this week against a 10 to 20 range, while chest has 24. Move two chest slots to rows.

insights.title: Legs are almost untrained
insights.body: Quads have 3 sets this week. Two compound leg sets would more than double that.

insights.title: Dumbbell bench is progressing well
insights.body: It went from 71.6 to 78.3 with 5 records in 28 days. Nothing to change there.
